definitions: To lack common sense or intellectual capacity.
examples: He's not the brightest person in the world, but he's kind-hearted.
Sometimes I think she's not the brightest person in the world, given her decisions.
lemma: not be the brightest person in the world
synonyms: not be the sharpest tool in the shed
not be playing with a full deck
source: not be the brightest person in the world
